context.composition_contract: composition/*: immediate authored/direct or materialize-then-consume; identical predicate and reduction; case selects plan and active mask

limits: Execution-family labels do not set the ISA ceiling; retain profile and target together.
Same-source sequential case observations, not ABBA candidate deltas or confidence intervals.
Fastest measured native variant is post-measurement selection among registered controls, not a default dispatch policy.
Larger native grains and benchmark-only deferred carrier controls have their own admissions; no general CPS ABI or arbitrary-placement inference.
